CESO 111 Regional Director, DILG-Region VIII Regional Office No. VIII Kanhuraw Hill, Tacloban City Dear Director Noval: Opinion No. 5 s, 2012 DILG 4 2012 CENTRAL SIGNATURE: — DAYE: This pertains to your letter regarding the letter-query of Mr. Jesus L. Horca, City Local Government Operation Officer, Ormoc City seeking guidance on the proper implementation of the Comelec Resolution in relation to DILG Circular No. 2010-19 re: Delegation of Authority — DILG-LG Sector. In his letter, Mr. Jesus L. Horca, posited the following queries which we quote, viz: "1) With respect to our Department's administrative rules and procedures, is there still a need for the DILG Ormoc field office to secure authorization and/or order from the DILG Central or Regional Office in order to implement the above-mentioned certification of finality from the COMELEC en banc? 2) As per information from the COMELEC's Ormoc Election Officer, the official copy of the Certificate of Finality has already been mailed to this Office by the COMELEC central office, but unfortunately the said copy has not yet arrived. Because of that, the City's Election Officer has given us a fax copy of the certificate of finality which she obtained from the COMELEC central office. Now sir, our question is will this fax copy from the COMELEC Ormoc suffice as our basis in implementing the certificate of finality or are we still going to wait for the copy which was mailed by the COMELEC en banc? 3) Since this Office releases monthly clearance to the barangay councils in the LGU after checking their sessions' minutes and accomplishment reports in order for the council to be allowed to receive their honorarium, are we still allowed to release clearance to Barangay Sumangga for the month of November considering that the signatories to their minutes and accomplishment reports is still Dionesio V. Dalumpines and that the Certificate of Finality is dated November 14, 2011." In reply to the first query, please be informed that under DILG Circular No. -DILG-LG Sector", entitled : "Delegation of Authority 2010-09 Orders/Decisions/Resolutions of the Office of the Ombudsman, Office of the President, Comelec and Sandiganbayan involving local officials and personnel shall be implemented by the SILG or all other local officials and personnel at Under Secretary level signing "By Authority of the Secretary". Such being the case the DILG Ormoc field officer must secure first an authorization/order from the SILG

-2- before he will implement/serve the implementation Order/Decision/Resolution from the Comelec En Banc. On the other hand, if the DILG Ormoc field officer or any DILG field personnel was the one directed by the Comelec En Banc to implement the said Comelec Resolution, the said personnel must still first secure an authorization/order from the SILG before he will implement the same. In reply to the 2 d query, we answer in the negative. The fax copy of the certificate of Finality from the Comelec Ormoc will not suffice as the basis in implementing the Certificate of Finality. The bases of the implementation must be the original copy of the Certificate of Finality as endorsed to us by the Comelec and a corresponding order from the Comelec En Banc, directing either the DILG field personnel or the City Election Officer to cause the immediate implementation of the said Certificate of Finality and/or Comelec Resolution such being the case, without any order of execution from the Comelec En Banc, the said Certificate of Finality and/or the Comelec En Banc Resolution must not be implemented. In reply to the last query, we answer in the affirmative. Please be informed that if the Certificate of Finality and/or the Comelec En Banc Resolution has not yet been served to Punong Barangay Dionesio V. Dalumpines as represented in the letter of Mr. Horca, therefore Mr. Dalumpines is still the recognized Punong Barangay of Barangay Sumangga until the said Comelec En Banc Resolution and the Writ of Execution ordering Punong Barangay Dalumpines to vacate are completely served upon him. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADE Undersecretary LS:94/11
